functions.name: Matrix4_Invert
functions.note: 4 x 4 inverse by Gauss-Jordan on [M | I]: per column the permuted row with the largest magnitude above 1e-6 (strictly), scaled by 1 / pivot, others r = (-r_k) pivot + r; the view's +0x2c8 from +0x288; AggregateCulling.Invert4

functions.name: Frustum_PlanesFromMatrix
functions.note: six planes from a row-major world-to-projection: r3 - r0, r3 + r0, r3 - r1, r3 + r1, r3 + r2 (r2 with the flag), r3 - r2 (the near plane when degenerate); (n, -w) normalised by 1 / sqrt((x x + y y) + z z) when >= 1e-20; AggregateCulling.ExtractPlanes

functions.name: Frustum_PackPlanes
functions.note: six planes as two SoA blocks of four (normals, d, sign masks, absolute normals) at view +0x30; AggregateCulling.Pack

functions.name: View_BuildProjection
functions.note: the projection, then +0x288 (18174f330), the planes (1817465f0) moved to the camera, d + ((nz (-oz) + ny (-oy)) + nx (-ox)), and packed (1817435e0); AggregateCulling.FaceFrustum

functions.name: GamePipeline_DepthPrepassLayers
functions.note: the game view's prepass layers: Large +0x6d0 = r_csgo_depth_prepass_cull_threshold (1825f6150, 60) / 100, Small = -that; AggregateCulling.PrepassSplit

functions.name: Pipeline_DepthPrepassLayers
functions.note: creates Depth Prepass Large / Small / AlphaTested with +0x6d0 = threshold / 100 and its negation (the 3D skybox passes r_csgo_depth_prepass_skybox_small_cull_threshold)

functions.name: BuildCubemaps_FaceToStrip
functions.note: a face's RGBA16F readback to a float bitmap (1813db210), QuarterSize (1813ddd00) down to EnvironmentMapFaceSize, flipped (1813dc290), copied into the 6x1 strip at x = face * size (181756620); Cubemaps/CubemapFaceExr.cs

functions.name: BuildCubemaps_WriteExr
functions.note: the strip as an uncompressed half EXR through tinyexr's fast writer (1813dede0), channels B, G, R; Cubemaps/CubemapFaceExr.cs

functions.name: Convar_buildcubemaps_renderdoc_capture
functions.note: registration of buildcubemaps_renderdoc_capture ("Capture a specific cubemap with RenderDoc during buildcubemaps.") with flags 2, development-only: a release build hides it from the console and the command line; its data pointer is the global 18237eab0

functions.name: g_buildcubemaps_renderdoc_capture
functions.note: the convar's data pointer (name at +0, int value at +0x58); BuildCubemaps compares the value with the cube counter (from 0) and calls the render device's StartCapture (vfunc 0x638) and EndCapture (0x640) around that cube; read at 18020e5cc and 18020f5b2. cubehost --renderdoc-capture writes it in its own process
